protocols.aam: Frozen original engine; explicit H; both directions; seed 10; cap 100; matching tolerance 1.0; event threshold 0.5; sweep cut.

protocols.smiles: Cached xTB MOL exported without valence repairs; all explicit atoms, no implicit H. Input compatibility only; not equivalent to native WBO graphs or curated chemical SMILES.

tolerance_ab.cap123: No substitution with old cap-200 run; all new cases start at cap 100.
